summary: PostgreSQL VACUUM removes dead tuples and ANALYZE gathers planner statistics in pg_statistic; keep autovacuum on, but schedule manual vacuums in maintenance windows if the database never idles. Tune memory GUCs in postgresql.conf, starting with shared_buffers (default 128 MB, set to 15 to 25% of RAM).
